# Parcelcraft — report v1

*Sample report, invented for the demo.*

## Brief

Returns portal, reverse-logistics routing and refunds for D2C brands. Clear retention story; diligence is on unit economics of the per-return fee.

## Why it could work

- The team has done this before.
- Customers expand once they are in.

## What would have to be true

- The pricing holds at larger customers.
- Distribution scales beyond the first region.

## Thesis fit

Inside the fund's stage and sector focus.
